subject: Write operator runbook
description:
Write `docs/runbook.md` covering the §11.4 minimum operator scenarios.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] Section: "Capo isn't responding" — check launchd status, check Logfire for last span, check AMC reachability.
- [ ] Section: "A delegation is hung" — `/status`, then `get_delegation_output` tail, then `/kill` if needed.
- [ ] Section: "Cost cap fired unexpectedly" — query `daily_costs`, check Logfire run costs, override via `override` reply.
- [ ] Section: "Restore state.db and dbos.db from Litestream" — exact paired-restore commands + WAL handling.
- [ ] Section: "Replace a SOUL file" — edit + restart.
- [ ] Each section includes the exact commands to run (copy-pasteable).

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Document what to do when restore points for `state.db` and `dbos.db` are not perfectly aligned.

**Testing Requirements:**
• Review: operator follows the runbook in a dry-run incident drill (Phase 5 manual verification)

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 9.5, 11.4
